scientific_question: For Phoenix, Arizona on 2025-07-01, is the midpoint of NASA POWER daily maximum and minimum 2 m air temperatures within 3 degrees Celsius of NASA POWER's daily mean 2 m air temperature?

scientific_contract.rationale: Tests a common daily-temperature midpoint approximation against the authoritative daily mean on a fixed historical day without assuming the answer.

goal_text: Using the authoritative JSON source https://power.larc.nasa.gov/api/temporal/daily/point?parameters=T2M_MAX&community=RE&longitude=-112.0740&latitude=33.4484&start=20250701&end=20250701&format=JSON, extract JSON path properties.parameter.T2M_MAX.20250701 and save the knowledge evidence to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PARENT_METEOROLOGY_TMAX.json. Using the authoritative JSON source https://power.larc.nasa.gov/api/temporal/daily/point?parameters=T2M_MIN&community=RE&longitude=-112.0740&latitude=33.4484&start=20250701&end=20250701&format=JSON, extract JSON path properties.parameter.T2M_MIN.20250701 and save the knowledge evidence to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PARENT_METEOROLOGY_TMIN.json. Using the authoritative JSON source https://power.larc.nasa.gov/api/temporal/daily/point?parameters=T2M&community=RE&longitude=-112.0740&latitude=33.4484&start=20250701&end=20250701&format=JSON, extract JSON path properties.parameter.T2M.20250701 and save the knowledge evidence to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PARENT_METEOROLOGY_TMEAN.json. Calculate the daily midpoint temperature using midpoint = (tmax + tmin) / 2. Determine whether the two temperatures differ by at most 3.

independent_oracle.method: Re-fetch the three exact NASA POWER URLs outside the Brain producer, independently extract the fixed-date values, recompute midpoint, absolute delta and the frozen 3 C decision, then compare every consequential producer value.
